description: Asks the user ONE question in the app and waits for the answer. Give 2-5 options (the first can be your recommendation); the user can also type their own answer. Every option should be {label, info}: label is a short answer, info is one or two plain sentences saying what that choice means and what you will do differently in the edit (the user sees it on hover). Use it for guided edits and for creative choices that matter. Do not ask what you can see or measure yourself.

allow_text.description: Let the user type something else. Default true

options.description: 2-5 answers: each {label, info} (a plain string also works). info = what it means and what you will do for the edit

name: ask_user

description: Lists a folder the user opened in the Files tab (names, kinds, sizes, and the length and resolution of videos and audio, read from file headers only: nothing is decoded or viewed). Without a path it lists the opened folders. Paths outside them are refused. Use it to tell the user what a folder contains and what looks usable, then import_media the files that are needed.

path.description: Absolute path of an opened folder or a folder inside one. Omit to list the opened folders

name: browse_folder

description: SCRIPT MODES: shows the user a drafted script in a window where they can edit, reorder and approve it, and waits. Returns 'APPROVED' with the final script (build exactly that with build_edit) or 'CHANGES REQUESTED' with their feedback (revise and propose again). One beat per planned cut or title card.

beats.description: In playing order. Each: {title, detail, asset_id (optional), start_ms, end_ms (source range, optional), seconds (planned length), join (cut|crossfade|...), sound (keep|mute|music only...), text (title or caption, optional)}

logline.description: The idea in one or two sentences

notes.description: Music, look, alternative idea, anything else the user should know

name: propose_script

description: Lists the director skills (editing craft guides). Start with director-brief for any creative request.
name: list_skills

description: Returns the full text of a director skill by name (see list_skills).
name: get_skill

description: Sets the movie canvas. Give a preset (16:9 = 1920x1080, 9:16 = 1080x1920, 1:1 = 1080x1080, 4:5 = 1080x1350) and/or width, height, fps. Clips are fitted inside; use set_transform to fill the frame.
name: set_format

description: Returns the whole project: assets, tracks with clips (times in ms), transitions, duration and playhead. Track 1 in the list is the top layer.
name: get_project

description: Imports a video or audio file (MP4/MOV/M4A/WAV/MP3...) by absolute path into the media bin.
name: import_media

description: Puts an imported asset on the timeline. Defaults: appended after the last clip on the first matching track; whole asset.

source_in_ms.description: Offset into the asset to start from

name: add_clip

description: Adds a text title overlay (drawn on top of the video).

preset.description: Ready-made style, see the titles-and-text skill

name: add_title

description: Changes the text of a title clip.
name: set_title_text

description: Moves a clip to a new timeline position. Clips on a track may not overlap, except as a transition.
name: move_clip

description: Changes which part of the source a clip shows. Omitted values keep the current value.
name: trim_clip

description: Splits a clip in two at a timeline position inside it.
name: split_clip

description: Deletes a clip (and its transitions). With ripple, later clips on the track move earlier to close the gap.
name: remove_clip

description: Copies a clip to the end of its track.
name: duplicate_clip

description: Removes a file from the media library. Clips that use it are removed from the timeline too.
name: remove_asset

description: Plays a clip faster or slower (0.1...8, 1 = normal). The clip gets shorter or longer on the timeline and later clips on the track move with it.
name: set_speed

description: Colour and geometry adjustments of a video clip. Omitted values keep the current value.

crop_left.description: Trim this fraction (0...0.9) off the left edge

split_amount.description: 0...1 strength of the two tints (teal and orange look: 0.5)

split_highlights.description: Tint for bright areas, hex e.g. FF9A3C

split_shadows.description: Tint for dark areas, hex e.g. 0B6E7F ('' removes)

name: set_look

description: Track settings: mute audio, hide picture or titles, lock, duck (music under speech), name. Omitted values keep the current value.

duck.description: Audio tracks: dip the volume while other sound (speech, clip sound) plays, e.g. for music

duck_level.description: How far a ducking track dips: 0.05...0.95 of its volume, default 0.3

locked.description: Protect the track's clips from changes

name: set_track

description: Adds a transition between a clip and the clip that starts exactly where it ends. The clips then overlap, so the timeline gets shorter by the duration.

duration_ms.description: Default 1000, capped at half the shorter clip

name: add_transition

description: Removes the transition that a clip is part of; later clips move back.
name: remove_transition

description: Sets a clip's volume (1 = original, 0...2) and fades. Omitted values keep the current value.
name: set_audio

description: Adds a built-in sound effect: Whoosh, Impact, Riser, Ding, Sparkle, Pop, Click, Shutter, Heartbeat, Rain, Wind, Beep. ONLY when the user asks for sound effects; films and highlight reels do not get automatic effects.
name: add_sound_effect

description: QUICK MECHANICAL first pass on an EMPTY timeline: chains the busiest moments of the video assets at similar lengths with one kind of crossfade, optionally on the beat of music. It does not look at the pictures or judge them, so it is NOT directing. For a real film use the director skills and build_edit. Only use this when the user asks for a quick automatic cut.

asset_ids.description: Video assets to use, in order. Default: all video assets

music_asset_id.description: Audio asset to cut on the beat of

name: auto_movie

description: Saves the project (not the rendered video) to an absolute path ending in .moviemaker. Media files are referenced by path, not copied.
name: save_project

description: Opacity, scale and position of a video clip. Omitted values keep the current value. Offsets are fractions of the frame (x + is right, y + is up).
name: set_transform

description: Styles a title clip. Omitted values keep the current value. Position is the text centre as a fraction of the frame (x from the left, y from the bottom).

align.description: Text alignment; x is where the text starts, centres or ends

glow.description: Glowing halo in the text colour

tracking.description: Letter spacing as a fraction of the size, e.g. 0.3

name: set_text_style

description: Changes the style and/or overlap length of the transition a clip is part of. A longer overlap makes the timeline shorter.
name: update_transition

description: Moves the sound of a video clip onto its own audio clip (same range) and mutes the video clip.
name: detach_audio

description: Adds an empty track. A video track on top is a new layer above the others; the first track in the list is the top layer.

on_top.description: Put it first (top layer). Default false

name: add_track

description: Deletes a track with all its clips.
name: remove_track

description: Built-in free sounds: sound effects and music beds with their tempo and mood. Use add_sound_effect / add_music, or search_online_sounds for more.
name: list_sounds

description: Adds a built-in music bed (about 1 minute, tempo known) on an audio track at a position, trimmed to the movie length if you give duration_ms. See list_sounds.

duration_ms.description: Default: the whole track, at most the movie length when the movie has clips

name: add_music

description: Searches free sounds online (Openverse: CC0, public domain, and optionally CC BY with credit). Returns ids; use import_online_sound to download one.

allow_attribution.description: Include CC BY sounds (you must credit them). Default true for music, false for effects

kind.description: music (20 s or longer), effects (up to 1 minute) or images (photos; import them, then use add_clip)

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'upbeat acoustic' or 'door slam'

name: search_online_sounds

description: Downloads a sound found with search_online_sounds into the media library and returns its asset_id (then use add_clip). Credits are recorded; see get_credits.
name: import_online_sound

description: Credit lines for all downloaded sounds that need attribution; paste them in the video description.
name: get_credits

description: Scene effects you can add to a video clip, with what each is for. Read the scene-effects skill for taste.
name: list_effects

description: Adds a scene effect to a video clip (an effect of the same type is replaced). amount is the strength 0...1.

color.description: Hex colour to remove, for chromaKey (default 00FF00)

name: add_effect

description: Removes a scene effect from a clip by type.
name: remove_effect

description: Builds a whole directed edit in ONE undoable step from an edit decision list: the cuts (which part of which clip, in order) with per-cut transition, speed, sound, look, framing and effects, plus titles, music and sound effects. This is the main tool for making a film. Read the edit-decision-list skill for the format.

cuts.description: In playing order. Each: {asset_id, start_ms, end_ms (source range), transition (none|crossfade|...; join with the previous cut), transition_ms, speed, sound (keep|mute|0..2), fade_in_ms, fade_out_ms, look (preset name or {brightness,contrast,saturation,sepia,blur,vignette}), scale, offset_x, offset_y, opacity, effects:[{type,amount}]}

music.description: {name (built-in, see list_sounds) or asset_id, volume (default 0.6), start_ms, source_in_ms, duck (lower the music under clip sound)}

overlays.description: Drawn overlays, each: {kind (confetti|snow|rain|sparkles|bokeh|dust|sunbeams|frame|hearts|fireflies), start_ms (timeline), duration_ms, amount, fade_in_ms, fade_out_ms}

replace.description: Start over when the timeline already has clips (the user can undo)

sfx.description: Sound effects. ONLY when the user asked for them. Each: {name, at_cut (cut index) or at_ms, offset_ms, volume}

titles.description: Each: {text, start_ms (timeline), duration_ms, preset (center|lowerThird|subtitle), size, color, x, y, align, bold, shadow, outline, box, fade_in_ms, fade_out_ms}

name: build_edit

description: Points an asset whose file moved to its new location (same kind of media, long enough for the clips that use it).
name: relink_asset

description: Links two or more clips so they move, split and delete together (e.g. a video clip and its detached sound).
name: group_clips

description: Dissolves the group a clip belongs to.
name: ungroup_clip

description: Animates a clip's opacity, scale, position and rotation over time with keyframes (time from the clip start). Values glide between keyframes and hold after the last. An empty list removes the animation. Omitted fields default to opacity 1, scale 1, offsets 0, rotation 0.

keyframes.description: Each: {time_ms, opacity, scale, offset_x, offset_y, rotation, smooth (ease, default true)}

name: set_keyframes

description: Detects quiet stretches in a clip's sound and cuts them out, closing the gaps (the picture is cut too). Good for talking clips.
name: remove_silence

description: Sets a clip's volume so its sound is at a standard level (about -20 dBFS), keeping its fades.
name: normalize_audio

description: Cleans a clip's sound: removes low rumble and gates the hiss in the pauses. A video clip's sound is detached onto its own audio clip first (grouped). Simple noise reduction.
name: reduce_noise

description: Transcribes the speech of a clip and adds subtitles on a Captions track, timed to the clip. Needs the Eclipse app (speech recognition permission).
name: auto_captions

description: Writes the subtitles (Captions track, or all titles) as an .srt file.
name: export_srt

description: Adds an emoji sticker (a large animated title) at a timeline position. Move it with set_text_style x / y.
name: add_sticker

description: Puts a clip back to plain: removes its look, framing, keyframes, effects, speed change and volume changes.
name: reset_clip

description: File facts of an imported asset: size, format, resolution, frame rate, codecs, sound, and how it is used in the project.
name: asset_info

description: Drawn overlay layers you can add with add_overlay (confetti, snow, ...).
name: list_overlays

description: Adds a drawn overlay (confetti, snow, rain, sparkles, bokeh, dust, sunbeams, frame, hearts, fireflies) on a video layer above the picture.
name: add_overlay

description: Creative directions for a film: three DIFFERENT, coherent starting points (structure, joins, look, one signature touch, title style, speed use, restraint), varied on every call and avoiding the ones suggested last time. Call it before planning a creative film, pick one (or blend two) that fits the footage and the mood, and say which you chose and why. Read the creative-toolbox skill for how to use it.

mood.description: Words for the feeling or kind of film, e.g. 'party highlight' or 'calm travel memories'

name: suggest_treatments

description: Complete film styles (colour grade, effects, joins, title look, overlay, suggested music) you can apply to the whole movie or to chosen clips with apply_template.
name: list_templates

description: Applies a film style (see list_templates) in one undo step: colour grade and effects on the video clips, the join style between clips, title look, and an overlay over the movie. It replaces the clips' earlier look and effects. Use clip_ids to style only some clips.

clip_ids.description: Only these clips. Default: all video clips

music.description: Also add the template's suggested music bed. Default false

overlay.description: Add the template's overlay. Default true

name: apply_template

description: Speed Ramp Studio: smooth changes of speed inside one clip (slow motion into normal into fast), from a preset or your own curve. The clip becomes a chain of pieces; the movie gets longer or shorter by the difference and later clips follow. Presets: Slow-mo dip, Hero pause, Ramp up, Ramp down, Speed burst, Slow ending, Slow start, Pulse.

points.description: Or your own curve: [{position 0...1, speed 0.1...8}] with rising positions, e.g. [{position:0,speed:1},{position:0.5,speed:0.3},{position:1,speed:1}]

segments.description: Smoothness: pieces to cut the clip into, 4...40, default 20

name: ramp_speed

description: Smart Match Cuts: finds pairs of moments in two clips that look alike (colour, brightness, where the bright shape sits) so a hard cut between them feels like one motion, e.g. a round sun into a spinning wheel. Returns times to cut out of one clip and into the other.

asset_ids.description: Clips to compare. Default: all video assets

name: find_match_cuts

description: Adds a match cut at the end of the timeline: the first clip plays up to time_a_ms, the second continues from time_b_ms (use the numbers from find_match_cuts).

lead_ms.description: How much of the first clip to show before the match, default 1800

tail_ms.description: How much of the second clip after the match, default 2500

name: add_match_cut

description: Smart Reframe: makes a landscape clip fill a vertical or square canvas and follows the main person or subject (faces first, then people, then the most eye-catching area). Set the canvas first (set_format) or pass aspect.

aspect.description: Optional: set the movie canvas to this shape first

name: smart_reframe

description: Undoes the last edit.
name: undo

description: Redoes the last undone edit.
name: redo

description: Facts and an activity/loudness summary of an imported clip, plus suggested best moments and probable cuts. Use before watch_asset.
name: inspect_asset

description: Contact sheet image of evenly spaced frames of an imported clip, each labelled with its time. Narrow start_ms/end_ms and raise frames to study a moment.
name: watch_asset

description: Contact sheet of the EDITED result (clips, transitions, titles, looks) between two timeline times. Use it to review your work.
name: watch_timeline

description: Speech to text with timestamps (ms) for an imported clip, using Apple's recognizer. The first call may ask the user for permission.

language.description: Locale like en-US or nl-NL. Default: the Mac's language

name: transcribe_asset

description: Returns an image of the composited frame (clips, transitions, titles) at a timeline time, so you can check your edit.
name: get_frame

description: Renders the project to an H.264/AAC MP4 at the given absolute path (can take a while). Optionally pick a preset: youtube720, youtube1080, youtube4K, tiktok, instagramFeed, square. Clips are fitted into the preset's frame.

preset.description: Optional size preset; default is the movie's own canvas

name: export

description: OFFLINE MODE: opens a viewer in the app where the user watches their video files one by one and marks 'start here' and 'end here' for the parts that matter. Waits until they press Done and returns, per file, the ranges in milliseconds (use them as start_ms/end_ms in build_edit). You cannot see the footage yourself. Call it once, early.

asset_ids.description: Optional: only these files (ids from get_project). Default all videos

reason.description: One short sentence shown to the user, e.g. 'Mark the best moments of each clip'

name: request_selection
